title: Operando Heating and Cooling Electrochemical Liquid-Cell STEM
content: In this talk, I will introduce the development of operando electrochemical liquid-cell STEM (EC-STEM to elucidate operando (operating) structure-property relationships of nanocatalysts for CO2 reduction to liquid fuels [1-3]. Operando electrochemical 4D-STEM in liquid, assisted by machine learning, has shown great potential to interrogate complex structures of active sites of energy materials at solid-liquid interfaces. I will discuss the technical challenges in developing operando EC-STEM with an emphasis on the reliability of Pt pseudo reference electrode (RE) under various chemical environments. I will then introduce the first-of-its-kind operando heating/cooling EC-STEM to investigate the dynamic growth of heterogeneous nanomaterials in liquid across a wide range of controlled temperatures.
